trust_decision.summary: Whether untrusted uploaded/e-mailed invoice XML (plain XML, PDF-embedded XML, PDF XMP metadata) may have external entities resolved by XML::LibXML; decided at the two load_xml calls in SL::XMLInvoice::new and SL::ZUGFeRD::extract_from_pdf, which at the pinned commit pass no entity/DTD options.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'uploading an electronic invoice in the ZUGFeRD format'; the upload action SL/Controller/ZUGFeRD.pm:135-139 dispatches to SL::ZUGFeRD->extract_from_xml, which calls SL::XMLInvoice->new (SL/ZUGFeRD.pm:221), whose load_xml is the obvious XML parse.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP controller=ZUGFeRD action=import_zugferd (SL/Controller/ZUGFeRD.pm:124) via extract_from_xml and via PDF-embedded attachment (SL/ZUGFeRD.pm:108); HTTP controller=EmailJournal action=ap_transaction_template_with_zugferd_import (SL/Controller/EmailJournal.pm:409); background job ImportRecordEmails (SL/BackgroundJob/ImportRecordEmails.pm:57 -> SL/Helper/EmailProcessing.pm:67-69); CLI scripts/xmlinvoice-cli.pl:31
same HTTP/background routes, PDF branch only: extract_from_pdf (SL/Controller/ZUGFeRD.pm:136, SL/Controller/EmailJournal.pm:429, SL/Helper/EmailProcessing.pm:67)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: SL/ZUGFeRD.pm:161 (separate load_xml on PDF XMP metadata, independent of SL::XMLInvoice; result used only for version warnings SL/ZUGFeRD.pm:165-198)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The XMP DOM is only used to set version warnings and nothing from it reaches the invoice data or the user, so a solver can argue it is 'just metadata detection, no exfiltration channel' and harden only SL::XMLInvoice::new.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legit CII/UBL invoices must still parse with namespaces and predefined/character entity references (e.g. '&' in party names) and XMP namespace detection must keep working; an over-broad fix (rejecting any '&'/DOCTYPE by regex, recover/strip, or failing on any entity) would break legitimate invoices or the factur-x/zugferd XMP version detection.

O6_input_shapes: XML invoice embedded as PDF attachment (SL/ZUGFeRD.pm:108 -> XMLInvoice::new)
e-mail journal attachment, PDF or XML (SL/Helper/EmailProcessing.pm:63-70)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a direct XML::LibXML pre-parse of attachment content (e.g. to sniff the root element before choosing a handler) using a separate load_xml call
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the module already imports XML::LibXML without using it, so a maintainer adding a quick content-type sniff here is plausible and sits in a different file from the parser factory

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a fallback re-parse in a child class check_signature/parse_xml (e.g. reparse with recover => 1 or via XML::LibXML->new->parse_string on a different input shape like a BOM-stripped or base64-wrapped XRechnung payload)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: XRechnung/UBL variants with odd encodings are a common reason to add a second tolerant parse path in the child parsers

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second XMP reader using a different PDF metadata source (e.g. the catalog Metadata stream) parsed with its own load_xml
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: _get_xmp_metadata is already a thin wrapper and PDF/A variants store XMP in more than one place

O10_build.toolchain: perl 5 with CPAN deps from SL/InstallationCheck.pm (XML::LibXML, PDF::API2, Rose::DB etc.); SL::XMLInvoice and SL::ZUGFeRD are testable as plain modules
O10_build.project_tests: none for ZUGFeRD/XMLInvoice parsing at the pinned commit (t/ only mentions ZUGFeRD/XMLInvoice in t/x/exceptions.t); scripts/xmlinvoice-cli.pl is a manual driver

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add expand_entities => 0 / no_network to SL::XMLInvoice::new only, leaving the XMP load_xml in SL::ZUGFeRD::extract_from_pdf untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: SL/Template/OpenDocument.pm:449 parses the print template content.xml (from SL/Template/OpenDocument.pm:391) with default load_xml; input is an admin-controlled template, not the advisory's untrusted invoice upload.
SL/Controller/ZUGFeRD.pm:149 creates a session file named from user-supplied form file_name; path handling not examined.
